name: Storybook Stick-Figure Cartoon
description: Stick-figure characters with large round heads over softly painted watercolour environments: clean black outlines, a warm earthy palette, and the friendly, readable register of a children's educational storybook.
style_bible: A drawn storybook cartoon where simple stick-figure characters stand inside softly painted places. Medium and surface: two clearly different materials in one picture. The characters and the props they hold are clean flat 2D digital drawing; the environment behind and around them is soft watercolour painting with visible wash variation, softened edges and a little paper texture. The seam between the two is deliberate — drawn figures on a painted world — and never blurred into one rendering style. Line: every character and prop is closed by a clean black outline of even, confident weight; the head is a large circle, the limbs are simple stick strokes with rounded ends, and the face carries only tiny dot eyes, a few sketchy black strokes for hair and at most a small curved mouth. Line weight does not vary much within a form, and nothing is cross-hatched. Fill: characters and props are flat colour or one soft cel step of shading; environments are painted in translucent watercolour with lighter and darker passages inside the same hue. Palette: warm and earthy — ochre, terracotta, sage, warm brown and cream for the figures and their clothing — against watercolour greens, dusty blues and warm neutrals in the places they stand. Lighting: soft and diffused throughout, with only a single gentle shading step on the drawn characters and no dramatic light anywhere. Composition: clean and uncluttered, one clear action per frame, highly readable silhouettes, generous space around the subject, and a rough, imperfect hand-drawn white border framing the picture. Content-independent: no fixed character, story, place or copied composition.
